pages.title: Eat the Unthinkable
pages.text: Not everything on the menu moos. $(item)Dead Irukandji$() — the jellyfish that kills you — makes a genuinely refreshing salad. $(item)Dead Stink Bugs$() fry crisp in butter. A $(item)Sea Viper Tongue$() on a stick is either a delicacy or a dare; the viper is no longer in a position to clarify.

pages.title: Borrowed Venison
pages.text: Gazelles now yield proper $(item)venison$() — the same cut the Twilight Forest deer carry, so every jerky and roast recipe that takes venison takes ours.$(p)Seared with strawberries and butter, it becomes $(item)Venison Medallions$(): the fanciest thing you can make from an animal that spent its life practicing running away.
